fields.direction: Plascore has no Ec, so its wrinkling stress is still open. The Hexcel stabilised modulus is QUESTIONABLE as Ec.
fields.effect: Foam wrinkling stays above the trimmed general-instability factor. Hexcel equibiaxial wrinkling safety factors are 0.0565286364026 and 0.0415196459641, below general instability, so that local mode would govern if it is admitted.
